q: The Bowen-Ruelle definition of topological pressure uses (n,ε)-spanning sets. Specifically:
opts: P(φ) = lim_{ε→0} lim_{n→∞} (1/n) log inf_{E spanning} Σ_{x∈E} e^{Sₙφ(x)}
P(φ) = lim_{n→∞} (1/n) log Σ_{x: T^nx=x} e^{Sₙφ(x)}
exp: Bowen's definition: P(φ) = lim_{ε→0} limsup_{n→∞} (1/n) log Z_n(φ,ε) where Z_n is the weighted partition function over (n,ε)-spanning sets. The alternative sum over periodic orbits gives the same pressure for Axiom A systems.
